question: A $1.5 million robot lasts 7 years, needs $150,000 of servicing yearly and does 300 operations a year. Fixed cost per operation, in dollars?
move: Spread a big purchase over every use before calling it cheap or dear.
trap: Forgetting the servicing, which adds about 70% to each year's cost.
hint: Turn the price into a yearly cost first, then share the year's cost out.
steps: Purchase spread over 7 years: 1,500,000 / 7 = about 214,000 a year.
reference: Barbash & Glied, New technology and health care costs: the case of robot-assisted surgery, New England Journal of Medicine, 2010
